fields.Brand Customer Promise: Reliable, affordable lodging with the Value Qs guests expect—Q Bed, Q Breakfast, Q Shower, Q Service, and Q Essentials—for family trips, weekend escapes, and business travel.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Founding Choice brand with 85+ years of heritage (2024 milestone materials); Value Qs deliver core comforts at competitive midscale pricing.

Owners: Fastest-growing midscale brand in Choice system with conversion-driven growth and high ROI positioning; strong awareness supports rate competitiveness.

Choice: 1,800+ hotels globally; Choice Privileges rated highly by USA Today and U.S. News.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Value Qs — bed, breakfast, shower, service, essentials.

Reliable affordability — the brand Choice was founded on.

Conversion growth — fueled by owner ROI and system scale.

Trusted midscale equity — competitive pricing power from awareness.
fields.Brand History: Quality is the brand upon which Choice Hotels was founded and remains committed to reliable, affordable lodging. The brand reports more than 1,800 hotels open globally, with 1,600+ in the United States.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Value-conscious business and leisure travelers who want predictable amenities—hot breakfast, comfortable bed, strong shower, friendly service, and free Wi-Fi—without paying for extras they will not use.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Founding Choice Hotels brand with deep awareness.

Value Qs amenity framework.

Conversion-friendly growth model for owners.

Global footprint with dominant U.S. presence.
